alt: Official California DHCS welcome/disenrollment letter confirming Nicolas Hernandez is disenrolled from Health Net, effective April 1, 2025.
summary: This official correspondence from the California Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) validates the formal disenrollment of Nicolas Hernandez from Health Net Community Solutions, effective April 1, 2025. This document represents a key step in the managed care transition process, marking the conclusion of the claimant's coverage under Health Net immediately prior to their enrollment in L.A. Care Health Plan. Within the scope of the forensic audit, this record serves to verify the chronological boundaries of the claimant's insurance coverage, establishing a clean transition timeline that is critical for determining plan liability and resolving outstanding reimbursement claims under the Conlan program.
